Capability: Rule-pack manager lists, creates, opens, saves and deletes project-scoped rule packs in the private local store, refusing edits without a project or while busy.
Notes: Desktop runtime backend only; browser preview reports an unavailable route. Raw document JSON remains the fallback editor for metadata members without form builders.

Capability: User validates a draft rule pack to see validation findings, and computes and stamps a canonical checksum into the draft document.
Notes: Validation and checksum are delegated to the rule-pack service; the panel only displays results.

Capability: Structured expression composer builds the typed formula tree (arithmetic, compare, logical, min/max, interpolate and lookup tables) through form controls with a read-only text preview.
Notes: No writable expression text and no parser by design. Table monotonicity and out-of-range handling are left to the evaluator and only surfaced as guidance.

Capability: Rule-pack document helpers parse draft text, collect declared variables and formulas, and rewrite a formula expression while preserving untouched members.
Notes: Client-side document manipulation only; canonical validation happens in the backend service.

Capability: User adds, removes and edits a rule pack's required inputs and value slots, including dimension, catalog unit, library value and solver result references.
Notes: Unknown values use an explicit TBD placeholder rather than silent defaults; placeholder provenance is private by default. Also exports shared form widgets reused by the check editor.

Capability: User authors acceptability checks that bind declared inputs, value slots and a formula, choosing basis, allowed result statuses and diagnostic codes from closed vocabularies.
Notes: Out-of-vocabulary stored values and unresolved references are shown as marked options rather than snapped to defaults.

Capability: Rule-check completeness panel reports why rule checking is blocked (missing user rule inputs, absent component provenance, unit policy) separately from mechanics status, with JSON export.
Notes: Findings are derived heuristically from status strings and model content; no dedicated unit test file for this panel.

Capability: User runs a rule pack's checks against the solved model, choosing the bundled demo, a saved local pack or pasted JSON, and sees per-check and worst-of aggregate user statuses.
Notes: Execution is desktop-only; browser preview reports an unavailable route. The saved-pack list control has no test that targets it directly.

Capability: Before a rule-check run the user supplies value slot entries, selects solver result rows and sees read-only previews resolving solver-result and library references and unit binding policy.
Notes: Previews never mutate the pack or invent a fallback binding; an authored in-pack solver reference overrides the panel selector.

Capability: Report packet panel summarizes model, units, statuses, component and hanger evidence, diagnostics, run hashes, comparison, persistence, editor intents and proposals, with redacted JSON export.
Notes: Raw report view is suppressed when redaction controls redact any value; only the sanitized JSON is offered.

Capability: User renders the calculation report through the native renderer, sees its canonical SHA-256, gate state and blocking reasons, previews it, and saves HTML or prints when not blocked.
Notes: Requires a solved result and analysis run. Printed output is a derived view naming the hash, not hash-bound evidence.

Capability: Builds the report renderer input document from session state: references, disclosures, section list, unit display summary and canonical hashes, keeping unknowns as visible TBD markers.
Notes: Document composition, gating and hashing of the final report are done by the native renderer, not here.

Capability: Builds a report package save request after verifying the input manifest, matching model hashes and finite results, and refusing when active rule-check metadata would need binding.
Notes: Called from the workspace session handler, not from a panel. Always refuses unless rule-check status is inputs-incomplete, so packages with rule results are not yet possible.

Capability: User records explicit local-private intent and saves a report package, seeing the redaction summary and save status.
Notes: Panel exposes controls only; the save handler and menu command live in the workspace shell.

Capability: Projects current-session model state, analysis run and comparison into report-section records, kept equal to a shared fixture produced by the backend section assembler.
Notes: Handoff section list is always empty in the desktop projection. Parity fixture builder is used only by the test. Packet carries hardcoded governance reference identifiers.

Capability: Applies export redaction controls to the three report routes: on-screen report and JSON, renderer input, and local-private package request.
Notes: Thin wrappers over the shared route export control.

Capability: Report content lint scans report surfaces for synthetic protected, private or proprietary markers and prohibited professional-authority phrases, producing blocking findings and lint JSON.
Notes: Pattern set is small and fixed (marker strings and four claim phrases); no dedicated unit test file.

Capability: Classifies export payload items by explicit privacy and redistribution metadata per export context, deciding include, warn, redact value or field, omit, or block export.
Notes: Mirror of a backend contract; parity pinned by a shared invented case corpus. Never infers sensitivity from value text; informational only.

Capability: Enforces local-first export routing: only allow-listed routes and valid contexts pass, local-private export needs explicit intent, and lossy redaction withholds lossless payloads.
Notes: Route allow-list is a hardcoded set of route id strings.

Capability: User picks an export context, records local-private intent, reviews redaction findings, and downloads a checksummed redacted model manifest only when nothing blocks.
Notes: Operates on a metadata-only representation of the current model; context defaults to local private.

Capability: Wraps every panel download link, mapping it to an export route and context, gating on intent, payload exactness and decoded-payload validation, and using native save in desktop.
Notes: Route binding is keyed on the link's test id string; unknown ids fall back to the default local-private JSON route. Used by many panels outside this area.

Capability: Load case manager lists load cases, primitive loads and combinations in virtualized, selectable lists with a boundary note.
Notes: No dedicated unit test file; covered through app-level tests.

Capability: User creates, edits metadata of and deletes load cases by queuing editor intents with a preview, rationale and provenance.
Notes: Queues intents only; the model is changed by the editor pipeline after review.

Capability: User creates primitive loads on pipes or supports, edits magnitude and unit checked against the unit catalog, and deletes them via queued intents.
Notes: Default units follow the project unit set; unit validity comes from the catalog service.

Capability: User creates load combinations, adds or removes terms, changes basis and factors, and deletes combinations via queued intents with previews.
Notes: Delete preview text must stay identical to the engine's display for before-state checks to pass. Basis vocabulary mirrors the load algebra engine.

Capability: User imports a material, section, component or hanger library document, validates provenance with blocking and advisory findings, and saves, lists, opens or deletes private local libraries.
Notes: Only accepted private imports are persisted; quarantined or rejected imports are refused. Desktop runtime only. Starts from an invented sample template.

Capability: User drafts library entries field by field (material properties with temperature reference, section quantities, component fields) using catalog units, then applies them to the document.
Notes: Linking library values to rule packs is not done here.

Capability: Secret and private-library review lists metadata-only private references, per-release-context guard decisions and no-bypass controls, with JSON export.
Notes: Read-only review; stores no credentials, reads no libraries and chooses no secret provider or encryption. Mounted in two places in the shell.

Capability: Project validation preflight reports schema and version, round-trip categories, unit round-trip, model and envelope hash evidence, migration evidence and persistence operations, with JSON export.
Notes: No dedicated unit test file.

Capability: Project storage audit reports storage capability, local-only boundary, snapshot and index, hash persistence and integrity, unit round-trip and payload boundary, with JSON export.
Notes: No dedicated unit test file.

Capability: Validation evidence review displays a static map of validation manual sections, evidence areas and states, release-readiness profiles and required paths, and release gates, with JSON export.
Notes: Inventory is hardcoded and can drift from the repository; the panel does not run the readiness tool. Packet carries hardcoded governance reference identifiers. Mounted in two places.
